name.ja: ケロロ軍曹プラモコレクション　タママロボ
name.en: SERGENT KERORO PLAMO COLLECTION　TAMAMA ROBO

ja: プレイバリュー満点のメカVer.に“タママロボ”発進！
ランナーから切り離しただけで手足が可動する約45mmのタママ二等兵が付属。
タママ二等兵は専用ソーサーに搭乗、そのまま飾れる専用台が付属。
ミサイルポッドは差し替え式で発射状態を再現。
en: “Tama Robo” launches in a mecha version with full play value!
Approximately 45mm Tamama private whose limbs can be moved just by separating it from the Runner is included.
Private Tamama rides on a special saucer, and comes with a special stand that can be displayed as is.
The missile pod is replaceable and reproduces the firing state.
